name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 7 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-10-18, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.32 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
